add.name: music-to-video
add.purpose: Turns a music track (file, video audio, or mood-brief-generated track) into a beat-synced HyperFrames video: lyric video, slideshow or kinetic promo; any supplied images/clips are cut onto the detected beat grid.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on beat-synced/music-driven video requests; part of the HyperFrames pack (`npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes`); needs Node + HyperFrames CLI.
add.evidence: Official HeyGen/HyperFrames; skills.sh ~275K installs; also on mcpservers.org. Closest public equivalent to a beat-cut-films workflow.
add.notes: Missing from list despite the other HyperFrames workflow skills being present.

add.name: ltx2
add.purpose: AI video generation with open-weights LTX-2.3 (22B): text-to-video and image-to-video clips for b-roll, animated stills and backgrounds, run on your own RunPod serverless endpoint.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on 'animate image', 'image-to-video', b-roll requests; needs a RunPod account/endpoint from the toolkit's docker images (pair with its runpod skill).
add.evidence: claude-code-video-toolkit (2.2k stars); toolkit already cited for acestep in audio_generation. Self-hosted open-weights i2v, the same shape as a stills->i2v cinematic pipeline.
add.notes: Repo was in sources_checked but this skill was not listed.

add.name: flux-3-video
add.purpose: Official Black Forest Labs router for FLUX 3 video: diagnoses the request and loads the right specialist (cinematic inserts, keyframes/i2v continuation, audio/dialogue, generate/poll).
add.how_to_use: Use for FLUX 3 text/image-to-video work; needs a BFL API key. Sibling skills flux-3-keyframes-continuation and flux-3-generate do i2v and job submission.
add.evidence: Vendor-official (Black Forest Labs); new FLUX 3 video skill family; sibling flux-3-product-ads already used elsewhere in the library.
add.notes: Router SKILL.md is short (~2KB); value is in the family of flux-3-* specialist skills.
